name: MARVILON Engineering Digital Thread and Assurance System (MEDTAS)
principle: No single file is the truth for the whole project. Each artifact class has a bounded authority; current project state is derived from their linked evidence.

authority_layers.authority: released geometry, topology, configurations, assembly links, native material where explicitly assigned
why a choice was made, alternatives, assumptions, release gates, rationale
observed solver/API/test result for a specific geometry/input/version
what must be satisfied and by which verification method
PartNo, description, make/buy, material release state, supplier/lot data; quantities from CAD assembly
current task/gate state only; never edits historical evidence

authority_layers.system: Git/GitHub; native CAD excluded from ordinary Git

state_transition_rule: A task changes state only when required evidence changes, or when a controlled engineering decision/work-package is revised. Dashboard buttons do not mark tasks PASS by themselves.
release_rule: Release is fail-closed. Missing, stale, inconsistent or unverified dependencies keep the parent gate HOLD/STALE.
